sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies & progress targets

stages.text: Play the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Scan every new vehicle and study animals through the binoculars while you travel — the 100% checklist later wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and progress made now still counts. Meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 5
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.text: After the credits, finish the side content that stays open: the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among them), the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and Bret's hunting quests. Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
stages.title: Strangers, side characters and the hunt

stages.text: Work through the checklist under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It is lenient — close to 60% of true completion, per PowerPyx: 70 of the 80 challenges, 42 shooting-range golds, 250 stunts (300 for the checklist), 14 drone-race locations, 20 races, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 200 vehicles scanned and 100 animals studied. Most of the trophies below fall out of this stage on their own.
stages.title: The 100% Completion checklist

stages.text: Finish the crime and money trophies: 5 of 8 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store without being seen, one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs), $250,000 laundered in Marked Bills, $100,000 spent, all 8 garages bought and 10 vehicles registered to Scooter Bros. Then sweep the one-off feats — the jet at VCIA, the Rhino at Mile Zero, the bowling alley in Port Gellhorn — and the platinum is yours.
stages.title: Money, crime and the last one-offs

summary: One playthrough, about 200 hours, difficulty 4 out of 10 (PowerPyx). No difficulty settings, no mission replay, free roam after the story — so do the one missable thing while you are in Chapter 1, and scan vehicles and study animals as you go.
title: Roadmap to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
warnings: Do the first meditation at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends — Positive Mental Attitude is the one trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable.
There is no mission replay after the story, so story trophies are earned by playing the missions when they appear.
Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep trophy runs cheat-free (PowerPyx, GTABase).
